To: Support leadership
From: Hana Okafor, Support Operations
Subject: Move tier-1 support to a follow-the-sun rotation

We should replace the night on-call shift with a follow-the-sun rotation across Dublin, Lisbon and Singapore starting in January.

Too much of our load lands on one person at night. The Q3 Zendesk export shows that 41% of escalations arrived between 22:00 and 06:00 CET, when a single on-call engineer covers the whole queue.

The night shift is also expensive. Finance's October review puts overtime pay for night on-call at EUR 186,000 a year.

People like working this way. Marta Lindqvist, who leads the Lisbon office, told me her team handled the late queue much better during the two weeks they tried a rotation in September.

Finally, a rotation will cut customer churn in half, because customers will never wait overnight for an answer again.

I'd like a decision at the December planning review.
